g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in, and the offer copy states the reward (priority routing for 60 minutes). Declining leaves the menu and replies as today, and the 'if the ad fails' field covers both no-fill and unverified play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority, which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event, returning to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry. No chat content is needed.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The 'adds' field introduces a new 24-hour cap on how many characters free users can text. That is a new limit on something free today, and it isn't a cap on model replies or queue priority, so 'removes nothing free: yes' is wrong.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the profile menu drawer (s09), a sheet over a non-chat screen rated safe, with no chat or characters nearby.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Priority routing is a paid Janitor+ benefit (s02.e06, m02), and the app limits it for free users (m03, inferred from s02.e07), so the app already charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: Its claims about the app today rest on s02.e06, s09.e31 and m03, which is inferred with cited evidence. The daily character cap and the claim that Janitor+ lifts it are what the proposal itself adds, so they don't count against this check.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 60 minutes and is capped at 2 per day. The app already sells queue priority, so this takes nothing from other users that isn't already for sale.

c5_moment.reason: The offer is on the profile menu, a persistent surface the user chooses to open, and it appears after they have looked at the upgrade entry. It interrupts no task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn rewarded game. The reward is granted only after the verified play, and the trigger is a detectable navigation event in the menu.

c7_specific.reason: It names Janitor+ priority routing, the s09 Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry, and the profile menu drawer, so it wouldn't read the same in another app.

other_concern: The daily limit on how many characters free users can text is invented and has no support in the product model. The 'when the reward runs out' copy claims Janitor+ lifts that limit, which the plan's benefits don't state. Declining the offer arguably leaves free users worse off than before because of the new cap.
